svg.text: End to end — commit to production
TRIGGER
git push to main
no human runs anything after this point
JOB 1 test
flake8 + pytest (matrix: both services)
GATE a failing test stops everything below
JOB 2 build
docker buildx -> multi-stage hardened image
tagged with the git commit SHA
JOB 3 scan
trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH
GATE exit code 1 fails the build
JOB 4 push
assume IAM role via OIDC -> push to ECR
no stored AWS keys anywhere
JOB 5 deploy
kubectl apply + set image BY DIGEST
rollout status --timeout is the final gate
ON FAILURE
kubectl rollout undo
previous ReplicaSet scaled back up in seconds
Why the image is tagged with the commit SHA and deployed by digest
A tag is a label that can be moved. A digest is the bytes and cannot be.
Deploy by digest and any running pod can be traced to one exact commit, months later, with certainty.
This is what makes an incident review possible instead of guesswork.
